TJpgDec - Tiny JPEG Decompressor R0.03
http://elm-chan.org/fsw/tjpgd/  (archive: arc/tjpgd3.zip, files from src/)

Local changes: tjpgdcnf.h only (JD_SZBUF 1024, JD_FORMAT 2 grayscale,
JD_TBLCLIP 0, JD_FASTDECODE 1). tjpgd.c and tjpgd.h are unmodified.

License text as stated in tjpgd.c:

  The TJpgDec is a generic JPEG decompressor module for tiny embedded systems.
